accessibility.contrast_ratio_minimum: 4.5:1 for body and data text, 3:1 for large display headers
accessibility.numeric_accessibility: Always use font-mono tabular-nums for financial amounts (INR ₹), tax deductions, EPF, ESIC, and PT values
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All actionable buttons, dropdowns, tab items, filters, modals, and metric cards MUST have data-testid in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='run-payroll-button', data-testid='employee-calculation-drawer-trigger')
accessibility.screen_readers: All status indicators have aria-label along with badge text. Currency symbols clearly designated

instructions_to_main_agent: Theme implementation: Update frontend/src/index.css with @fontsource-variable/outfit for headings, @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans for sans/body, and @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono for mono.

Navigation & Shell: Create a unified responsive app shell in frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx featuring a desktop 260px dark sidebar with collapsible state, top navbar with role switcher dropdown (Admin, HR, Finance, Employee Self-Service) and tenant selector, and a dedicated mobile bottom navigation bar.
Payroll Engine & State Workflow: Represent the lifecycle transitions clearly with interactive state buttons and status badges for DRAFT -> CALCULATED -> REVIEW -> APPROVED -> LOCKED.

Calculation Breakdown Drawer: Use shadcn Sheet component (frontend/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx) for the employee salary calculation inspection, showing Indian statutory deductions (EPF 12%, EPS, ESIC 0.75%/3.25%, Professional Tax slab, TDS with Old vs New regime rebate §87A) with exact formula breakdown.

Data Tables & Mobile Responsiveness: Render dense desktop data tables with sticky header and sort/filter capabilities, and automatically transform into stacked key-value cards on mobile viewports (<768px).
PWA Readiness: Include web app manifest metadata and install trigger component for mobile and desktop PWA installability.
Testing Attributes: Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, select, and status badge contains a descriptive data-testid attribute for end-to-end automated testing.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Generous container padding (p-6 to p-8 desktop, p-4 mobile). No cramped headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.numeric_precision: All currency values in Indian Rupees (₹) must be formatted with locale 'en-IN' and rendered with tabular-nums.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never apply global transition: all. Use targeted hover and active classes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_ai_slop_emojis: Never use AI robot emojis for icons. Use strictly Lucide-react SVG glyphs.
